# Inter-Operability {#sec-interoperability}
`QUESTION`

<!--
> What (meta)data standards, methodologies, vocabularies, are or will be followed 
> to ensure that the data can easily be used in combination with similar data from other sources 
> (so-called interoperable data)?
-->

Inter-operability of the data is mainly defined by the context of the MNE project: we build on prior experience and partially analogous projects which have been executed at our institute.
For primary data, we follow the established route of others at INBO and contribute to existing databases and systems (e.g. WATINA, AquaChem).
For secondary data which has not been framed in a common standard, we pursue inter-operability by transparency, putting efforts into documentation and reproducible query examples.
Data access and usage by others is facilitated by the application of open source programming in conventually used, widely available and extensible script languages (R, SQL, Python).
